cohort: 200 pregnant women in their third trimester with oligohydramnios at a government hospital in Salem, Tamil Nadu, India
finding: Oligohydramnios was associated with lower Apgar scores, higher rates of cesarean section, and a perinatal mortality rate of 3.7%.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was 59.4% while vaginal birth rate was 37.6% among women with oligohydramnios.
